source_caption:
📺 Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman (1993–1997)

Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman follows Clark Kent, a talented young journalist who moves to Metropolis and begins working at the Daily Planet while secretly using his extraordinary abilities to protect humanity as Superman. There, he meets Lois Lane, an ambitious and fearless investigative reporter whose determination often leads her into dangerous situations. As the two become reporting partners, Clark develops romantic feelings for Lois, while she becomes fascinated by Superman, unaware that they are the same person. Together, they investigate mysterious crimes, expose corruption, and confront dangerous villains, including the powerful businessman Lex Luthor. Meanwhile, Clark struggles to balance his superhero responsibilities with his desire for an ordinary life and a meaningful relationship. Starring Dean Cain and Teri Hatcher, the series delivers exciting adventures, memorable romance, entertaining humor, and heartfelt storytelling about love, trust, courage, identity, and the challenges of keeping extraordinary secrets.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Romance • Science Fiction • Superhero

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 46 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Developer: Deborah Joy LeVine

📺 Seasons: 4 • 87 Episodes

📚 Based On: The DC Comics character Superman, created by Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster.

📍 Setting: Metropolis.

📺 Where to Watch: Check HBO Max, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman is an American superhero television series based on the DC Comics character Superman created by Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster. It stars Dean Cain as Clark Kent / Superman and Teri Hatcher as Lois Lane. The series aired on ABC from September 12, 1993, to June 14, 1997. Developed for television by Deborah Joy LeVine, the series loosely followed the modern origin of Superman, established by writer John Byrne, in which Clark Kent is the true personality and Superman a disguise. The series focuses on the relationship and romance between Lois and Clark as much as the adventures of Clark's alter ego, Superman.
